about.description:
Gdstk (GDSII Tool Kit) is a C++ library for creation and manipulation of
GDSII and OASIS files.  It is also available as a Python module meant to
be a successor to Gdspy.  Key features for the creation of complex CAD
layouts are included: boolean operations on polygons (AND, OR, NOT, XOR)
based on clipping algorithm; polygon offset (inward and outward rescaling
of polygons); efficient point-in-polygon solutions for large array sets.
about.summary: Gdstk (GDSII Tool Kit) is a C++/Python library for creation and manipulation of GDSII and OASIS files.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: gdstk
  version: "1.0.2"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/heitzmann/${{ name }}/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 1c73118464a168f4094400f34dd0c6a0c80483fd5a8f8aea68d7cfb1e63c09ed
  target_directory: gdstk
  patches:
    - ./0001-Remove-unconditional-setting-of-CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTU.patch

build:
  number: 1
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install ./gdstk -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - numpy
        - python
    - cmake >=3.26.0
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - make
  host:
    - numpy
    - python
    - pip
    - scikit-build-core
    - qhull
    - wheel
    - zlib
  run:
    - typing_extensions
    - numpy
    - python

tests:
  - files:
      source:
        - gdstk/tests/*
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
    script:
      - pytest

about:
  license: BSL-1.0
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Gdstk (GDSII Tool Kit) is a C++/Python library for creation and manipulation of GDSII and OASIS files.
  description: |
    Gdstk (GDSII Tool Kit) is a C++ library for creation and manipulation of
    GDSII and OASIS files.  It is also available as a Python module meant to
    be a successor to Gdspy.  Key features for the creation of complex CAD
    layouts are included: boolean operations on polygons (AND, OR, NOT, XOR)
    based on clipping algorithm; polygon offset (inward and outward rescaling
    of polygons); efficient point-in-polygon solutions for large array sets.
  homepage: https://github.com/heitzmann/gdstk
  repository: https://github.com/heitzmann/gdstk
  documentation: https://heitzmann.github.io/gdstk/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - heitzmann
    - wshanks
